title: Novel Council Evaluator Output
description: All evaluator outputs in the Novel Council Layer MUST conform to this schema. Evaluators score only the dimensions within their expertise; all other dimensions are null. Evaluation is double-blind: input is anonymized (no author/work names) and the criteria are structural (no proper nouns).

evaluator_name.description: Human-readable display name of the evaluator.

evaluation_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the evaluation. Optional.

content_summary.description: One-line summary of what was evaluated.

content_type.description: Input form: full text / opening+summary (text), plot or synopsis concept (plot), or structured.

primary_score.description: The evaluator's overall score for this story through its own lens.

primary_score_rationale.description: Concise explanation of why this primary score was assigned. Optional; the narrative may cover the same content.

dimension_scores.description: Per-dimension breakdown. Dimension names are evaluator-specific.

weight.description: Relative weight of this dimension within this evaluator's framework.

evidence.description: Specific, quotable evidence from the story (structural, no proper nouns).

value_vector_contribution.description: This evaluator's contribution to the council's composite Story Vector. Only the evaluator's own dimension(s) are non-null.

classification.description: The evaluator's placement of this story in the 2x2 value matrix.

confidence.description: How confident this evaluator is in its own assessment.

red_flags_triggered.description: Which red flags were detected, if any.

green_flags_detected.description: Which green flags were detected, if any.

unique_perspective.description: What only THIS evaluator sees that others would likely miss.

evaluator_type.description: Type of evaluator expected to disagree (e.g., 'plot-architecture', 'anti-generic-filter').

predicted_stance.description: How that evaluator would likely judge this story differently.

expected_disagreement_points.description: Where this evaluator anticipates conflict with other perspectives. Optional; may be omitted or empty.

improvement_suggestions.description: Actionable suggestions for increasing value in this dimension.

narrative.description: 2-3 paragraph analysis in the evaluator's own voice. Captures what cannot be reduced to numbers.
